==Usage==
The usage of this template is governed by [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/In-universe#Template usage]]. An extract of the relevant points is provided below:

The {{Tl|ID}} template may be used to denote when an appearance uses an alternate name for a subject.
*Common usage examples include:
**Misspellings (example: {{ID|Dack Ralter}})
**Indirect appearances (example: {{C|Indirect appearance only}} {{ID|snowspeeder}})
**Call signs used in conjunction with {{Tl|Imo}} (example: {{Imo}} {{ID|Rogue Eleven}})
**Ambiguous proper-noun references (example: ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'' refers to the [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]] language using the phrase "from the Corellian"; thus, {{ID|Corellian}})
*{{Tl|ID}} may not be used:
**If the subject is referred to by the actual Wookieepedia article title or an abbreviation, alternate capitalization, nickname, or shortened version of its name (example: Jek Tono Porkins vs. Jek Porkins)
**For names already presented in the article using {{Tl|1stID}}
**On articles with conjectural titles
**For general phrases and terms (examples: {{ID|Rebel soldier}} for a named character; {{ID|attack on Hoth}} for [[Battle of Hoth]])
Note: {{Tl|C}} may not be used in substitution of {{Tl|ID}} or to circumvent the listed usage rules.
